versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.
The helper connects through Beatra's mainland network when your computer is in mainland China, and can open the approval page on Beatra's international site when you need another sign-in method.
The helper now waits for your approval, and if you approve after it has stopped waiting, Beatra connects automatically the next time you use it, with no second approval.
Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

- Added support for creating digital-human presenter videos by synthesizing narration with speech, then animating a portrait with video, following new constraints on admitted formats and durations.
- Clarified model discovery: specific capability-based payloads (e.g., {"capability":"text_to_video"}) must now be used for model selection and compatibility.
- Documented new commands for checking credits and viewing the wallet ledger via `beatra.wallet.get` and `beatra.wallet.ledger`.
- Updated video workflow documentation: narration for animated video must conform to the format/duration of the selected model.
- Removed skill-card.md; expanded and clarified SKILL.md for improved guidance on public social lookup, supported tools, and safe uploads.
Ask for the starter top-up before a video or voice clone, not before every other route.
Publish the reviewed Beatra Universal workflow with its English ClawHub listing.
